Daily Quiz.question: ১) Which literary work below is not written by Joseph Conrad?
Daily Quiz.exp:
চারটি অপশনের তিনটিই  Joseph Conrad এর লেখা। 
কেবলমাত্র Riders to sea  এর রচয়িতা John Millington Synge.


Joseph Conrad (1857-1924):
- English novelist and short-story writer of Polish descent.
- 'Lord Jim: A Tale' is one of the best literary works by Joseph Conrad. 

Other Novels:
- Nostromo (1904), 
- The Secret Agent (1907) 
- Heart of Darkness (1902).
- The End of the Tether
- Typhoon
- Nostromo
- The mirror of the sea. 
- The secret agent. 
   

Source: Britannica.com & An ABC of English Literature- Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'The Waste Land' is a poem written by________.
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Waste Land:
-  T. S. Eliot এর লেখা অন্যতম শ্রেষ্ঠ কবিতা এটি। 
- It is a long poem. কবিতার লাইন সংখ্যা ৪৩৩. 
- এই কবিতাটি উৎসর্গ করা হয়েছিল আরেক জন প্রথিতযশা আধনিক কবি Ezra Pound কে। 
- ২০ শতকের অন্যতম প্রভাবশালী কবিতা এটি। 

T.S. Eliot:
- Full name: in full Thomas Stearns Eliot
- Born: September 26, 1888, St. Louis, Missouri, U.S.
- Death: died January 4, 1965, London, England
- He was an American-English poet, playwright, literary critic, and editor.
- He was a leader of the Modernist movement in poetry.

Best Works:
- The Waste Land (1922)
- Four Quartets (1943).
- Murder in the Cathedral (Play)
- The Sacred Wood (Collection of Essays)

Source: www.britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) ”Mrs. Dalloway” is _______ written by Virginia Woolf.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Mrs. Dalloway:
- Mrs Dalloway (published on 14 May 1925[1]) is a novel by Virginia Woolf.
- It describes a day in the life of Clarissa Dalloway, who is a fictional high-society woman in post–First World War England. It is one of Woolf's best-known novels.

Virginia Woolf (1882-1941),
- She was a feminist.

Best Works:

-The Voyage Out (1915)
-Mrs. Dalloway (1925)
-To the Lighthouse (1927)
-The Waves (1931)
-Flush (1933)
-The Years (1937)

Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Who among the options below was awarded the Nobel prize in Literature?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Winston Churchill: 
- in full Sir Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill, (born November 30, 1874, Blenheim Palace, Oxfordshire, England—died January 24, 1965, London),
- British statesman, orator, and author who as prime minister (1940–45, 1951–55) rallied the British people during World War II  and led his country from the brink of defeat to victory. 
- He was awarded Nobel Prize in literature for depicting the history of World War II in a mesmerizing tone. 
- The Nobel Prize in Literature 1953 was awarded to Sir Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill "for his mastery of historical and biographical description as well as for brilliant oratory in defending exalted human values."- 

On the other hand, 
Theodore Roosevelt & Barack Obama were statesmen and was awarded the noble peace prize in 1906 & 2009. 

Source: https://www.nobelprize.org/ & Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who wrote the poetic drama, 'Murder in the Cathedral?'
Daily Quiz.exp:
Murder in the Cathedral
- এটা মূলত: T.S Eliot রচিত একটি  Poetic Drama। নাটকটি দুইটি ভাগে বিভক্ত। 
- St. Thomas Becket কে ক্যান্টারবেরির Cathedral বা গীর্জাতে রাজা হেনরি কর্তৃক অন্যায় ভাবে নিহত করার ঘটনাটি এখানে তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।
- এজন্য এই নাটকটিকে Miracle Play বা Saint’s Play ও বলা হয়ে থাকে।  

T.S. Eliot:
- Full name: in full Thomas Stearns Eliot
- Born: September 26, 1888, St. Louis, Missouri, U.S.
- Death: died January 4, 1965, London, England
- He was an American-English poet, playwright, literary critic, and editor.
- He was a leader of the Modernist movement in poetry.

Best Works:
- The Waste Land (1922)
- Four Quartets (1943).
- Murder in the Cathedral (Play)
- The Sacred Wood (Collection of Essays)

Source: britannica.com

Daily Quiz.exp:
The Luncheon"  by Willam Somerset Maugham is a short story.

- The Luncheon.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who is American from the authors below?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Walt Whitman(1819-1892):
- American poet, journalist, and essayist.

Best works:
- A Passage To India (poem),

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) The real name of O. Henry  is:
Daily Quiz.exp:
O’ Henry was the pseudonym of William Sydney Porter, an American short story writer.

O Henry: (1862-1910) pseudonym of William Sydney Porter. American short-story writer whose tales romanticized the commonplace—in particular the life of ordinary people in New York City.
O. Henry was a professional writer, he worked as a clerk in a drugstore.

Notable works: (Short stories )
- Heart of the West
- O. Henry Encore
- Roads of Destiny
- Sixes and Sevens
- Strictly Business
- The Four Million
- The Furnished Room
- The Gift of the Magi
- The Last Leaf
- The Ransom of Red Chief
- The Trimmed Lamp
- The Voice of the City
- Waifs and Strays
- Whirligigs

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Rudyard Kipling is the author of which book from the options below?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The Ant and the Grasshopper
Daily Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: The Jungle Book. 

এছাড়া, প্রদত্ত অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে, 

- The Ant and the Grasshopper একটি ছোটগল্প,  এর রচয়িতা William Somerset Maugham.
- The Voyage Out  উপন্যাসটি  Virginia Woolf এর লেখা প্রথম উপন্যাস। 
- The New Arabian Nights, ছোটগল্প সংকলন , লেখক: Robert Louis Stevenson. 
 

Rudyard Kipling: 
- Full name: Joseph Rudyard Kipling.
- He was an Indian born British Journalist.
- Born: December 30, 1865, Bombay [now Mumbai], India.
- Death:  January 18, 1936, London, England.
- English short-story writer, poet, and novelist.
- He is chiefly remembered for his celebration of British imperialism, his tales and poems of British soldiers in India, and his tales for children.
- He was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1907.

Best Works:
- Kim,
- The Jungle Book,
- Puck of Pook's Hill,
- Captain Courageous,
- Limits & Renewals,
- Just So Stories,
- Soldiers Three,
- The Light that Failed,
- Plain Tales from the Hills,
- Seven Seas,
- The White Man's Burden

Source: An ABC of English Literature- Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) 'The Satanic Verses' and 'Midnight Children' are two novels written by____.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Salman Rushdie:
- In full, Sir Ahmed Salman Rushdie
- Born: June 19, 1947 Bombay (Now Mumbai) India).
- Indian-born British writer

Key Works:
- Midnight's Children
- Shame 
- Satanic Verses 


Midnight's Children:
- Midnight's Children is a 1981 novel by author Salman Rushdie.
- Published by Jonathan Cape with cover design by Bill Botten.
- It portrays India's transition from British colonial rule to independence and the partition of India. 

 

The Satanic Verses:
- The Satanic Verses is the fourth novel of British-Indian writer Salman Rushdie. First published in September 1988.

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) ''The Good Earth'' is a -
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Good Earth:
- It is a historical fiction novel by American author Pearl S. Buck published in 1931 that dramatizes family life in a Chinese village in the early 20th century.

Pearl S. Buck:
- She was an American novelist and writer.
- She was awarded the Nobel prize in 1938 for her rich and truly epic description of peasant life in China in her novel , "The Good Earth."
- Pearl S. Buck was the first American woman to win the Nobel prize for literature.

Best Works:
- Dragon Seed
- East Wind, West Wind
- The Eternal Wonder
- The Good Earth”


Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who is the poet of the poem, 'The Wild Swans at Coole'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Butler Yeats (1865-1939):
- He was a poet, dramatist, and critic, famous for his use of symbolism and mysticism.
- Irish dramatist, poet, and critic.
- He is famous for his use of “Symbolism and Mysticism”.
- He wrote the preamble of Tagore's “Gitanjali” in 1912, which later got the Nobel prize in 1913.
- W.B. Yeats got the Nobel prize in 1923.

Notable Works:
-The Resurrection (1913)
-The Wild Swans at Coole (1919)
-The Cat and the Moon (1926)
-The Tower (1928)
-The Winding Stair and Other Poems (1933)

Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman &  ইংরেজি সাহিত্যের ইতিহাস শীতল ঘোষ.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) 'To the Lighthouse' ‍a novel written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
'To the Lighthouse' is a famous novel written by Virginia Woolf. 
- It was first published in 1927.
- The work is one of her most successful and accessible experiments in the stream-of-consciousness style.
- এই novel টি তিনটি section এ বিভক্ত।

Characters of this novel -
- Mrs. Ramsay
- Mr. Ramsay
- Lily Briscoe
- Charles Tansley

Virginia Woolf:

- Mrs. Dalloway
- The Waves

- Flush

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) "But I have promises to keep and miles to go before I sleep.” This is an excerpt from which famous poem?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Robert Frost in his Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening Poem, made this legendary line: "But I have promises to keep and miles to go before I sleep."

Robert Frost: 
- In full,  Robert Lee Frost, American poet.
- He was much admired for his depictions of the rural life of New England.
- His command of American colloquial speech, and his realistic verse portraying ordinary people in everyday situations.

Legendary/Best Poems:
- Road not Taken
- Mending Wall
- Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening
- Christmas Trees
- A Boy’s Will
- North of Boston
- Nothing Gold Can Stay
- After Apple-picking
- Home Burial.

Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.exp:
O’ Henry, pseudonym of William Sydney Porter(1862-1910): American short-story writer.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Who quoted this, "Common sense is not so common" ?
Daily Quiz.exp:
"Common sense is not so common" is a quotation from Voltaire. 

Voltaire (1694 – 1778):
- French historian and philosopher.
- “Voltaire” is the pen name under which French author-philosopher François-Marie Arouet published a number of books and pamphlets in the 18th century.
- He was a key figure in the European intellectual movement known as the Enlightenment. 

Best Works:
- Candide
- The Age of Louis XIV
- Henriade.
- Brutus
- The Tragedy of Zara
- Vision de Babouc

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) T. S Eliot was born in which country?
Daily Quiz.exp:
T. S. Eliot (Thomas Stearns Eliot)
-  He was born in  September 26, 1888, St. Louis, Missouri, U.S.
- ১৯৬৫ সালের ৪ জানুয়ারি তিনি লন্ডনে মারা যান।
- Eliot কে বিংশ শতাব্দীর অন্যতম শ্রেষ্ঠ সাহিত্যিক বিবেচেনা করা হয়। তিনি ১৯৪৮ সালে সাহিত্যে নোবেল পুরস্কার লাভ করেন।

Best works:
- The Waste Land (1922),
- Four Quartets,
- The Hollow Men,
- Ash Wednesday etc.
• His well known plays:
- Murder in the Cathedral,
- The Cocktail Party,
- The Trail of a Judge etc.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Nobelprize.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who wrote the popular novel, ''Crime and Punishment''?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Crime and Punishment:
- It is a novel by Russian writer Fyodor Dostoyevsky.
- It was first published in 1866.
- The novel is a psychological analysis of the poor former student Raskolnikov, whose theory that he is an extraordinary person able to take on the spiritual responsibility of using evil means to achieve humanitarian ends leads him to murder. 


Fyodor Dostoyevsky:
- He is a Russian Novelist and writer.
- Russian novelist and short-story writer whose psychological penetration into the darkest recesses of the human heart, together with his unsurpassed moments of illumination, had an immense influence on 20th-century fiction.
- Dostoyevsky is usually regarded as one of the finest novelists who ever lived.

Famous novels:
- Crime and Punishment,
- The Idiot,
- The Brothers Karamazov,
- Poor Folk,
- A Little Hero,
- The Eternal,
- Notes from Underground.

Source: লাইভ এমসিকিউ আপকামিং কনটেন্ট & Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) "Fern Hill" is ______ written by Dylan Thomas.
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Fern Hill is a poem written by Dylan Thomas. 
Dylan Thomas:
- In full Dylan Marlais Thomas.
- He is a British author.
- Also known as, Welsh poet and prose writer. 
- His work is known for its comic exuberance, rhapsodic lilt, and pathos.

Best Works: 
- 18 Poems
- 25 Poems 
- A Child’s Christmas in Wales
- Deaths and Entrances
- Fern Hill
- Under Milk Wood

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) 'Charlie Marlow' is a character from which novel?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Heart of Darkness
- এটা মূলত:  Joseph Conrad রচিত।  একটা Novella বা সংক্ষিপ্ত উপন্যাস। 
- এতে মূলত: পশ্চিমের দেশগুলোর ঔপনিবেশিকতা এবং সাম্রাজ্যবাদের বিভিন্ন ক্ষতিকর এবং নেতিবাচক দিক তুলে ধরার চেষ্টা করা হয়েছে। 
- এই কাজটি লেখকের  Semi-Autobiographical রচনা বলে গণ্য করা হয়। প্রথম দিকে তেমন সাড়া না ফেললেও পরবর্তীতে এটি বেশ আলোচনা এবং সমালোচনার জন্ম দেয়।
- Charlie Marlow এই উপন্যাসের অন্যতম প্রধান চরিত্র। 
- বিখ্যাত চলচ্চিত্র পরিচালক Francis Ford Coppola এর বিখ্যাত মুভি Apocalypse Now (১৯৭৯) এই Novella দ্বারা অনুপ্রাণিত।  

The major characters are :
- Marlow
- Kurtz
- General manager
- Brickmaker
- Chief accountant
- Pilgrims
- Cannibals
- Russian trader

Joseph Conrad(1857-1924):
- English novelist and short-story writer of Polish descent.
- His works include the novels Lord Jim (1900), Nostromo (1904), and The Secret Agent (1907) and the short novel “Heart of Darkness” (1902).

Source: Britannica &  www.sparknotes .com
